dedupeText: vintage harbor city album cover 1960s photography harbor city industrial port mid century typography dusk lighting grainy film warm artificial lights of the city contrasting with the cool desaturated blue grey sky horizontal text blocks anchored against the verticality of the clock tower industrial harbor elements in the background providing depth to the architectural foreground combine a desaturated grainy architectural landscape with bold high contrast mid century display type positioned in the negative space of the sky

recipe.visualDefinition: A wide-angle, slightly elevated dusk photograph of a European port city featuring a prominent clock tower and harbor activity, overlaid with bold, two-tone sans-serif and slab-serif typography in the upper third.
coreVisualRelationships: Warm artificial lights of the city contrasting with the cool, desaturated blue-grey sky
Horizontal text blocks anchored against the verticality of the clock tower
Industrial harbor elements in the background providing depth to the architectural foreground
coreInvariants: Desaturated teal-grey sky occupying the top half

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The St. Pauli Landungsbrücken architecture occupies the lower half; the clock tower is the primary vertical anchor on the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The illuminated clock face and the bright white ship in the mid-ground harbor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the bold red title, move to the yellow subtitle, then descend to the clock tower and follow the harbor line to the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Expansive, flat sky area used as a canvas for the primary typography.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep brown and charcoal (architecture and shadows)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation in the photographic base allows the high-saturation, high-value text to pop forward.
paletteRestrictions: No modern digital vibrance in the image

letterConstructionRules: Title uses ultra-bold, wide geometric sans-serif with tight kerning
Subtitle uses a heavy, rounded slab-serif with moderate tracking
characterSpecificRedesigns: None; relies on standard mid-century display faces
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High contrast between a wide, modern sans-serif and a traditional, sturdy slab-serif.

preserve: Color contrast between title and subtitle
avoid: Serif fonts for the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the weight and geometric feel of the primary title
Captures the mid-century slab-serif aesthetic of the subtitle

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a wide-angle photograph of a 1960s European harbor at dusk. Include a prominent stone clock tower on the left, a large white passenger ship in the harbor, and industrial cranes in the distance. The sky should be a flat, desaturated teal-grey. Use a grainy, vintage film aesthetic with warm streetlights.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add left-aligned text in the upper left quadrant. The top line should be in an ultra-bold coral-red geometric sans-serif. Below it, add two lines of text in a golden-yellow bold slab-serif.

verificationChecks: Text is left-aligned and positioned in the sky area
Image has a distinct 1960s film grain and color palette
Clock tower is a vertical focal point on the left

mustRedesign: Specific city landmarks to avoid copyright
Exact wording of the original text

avoid: Contemporary font choices like Helvetica or Arial

postGenerationChecks: Is the text legible against the sky?
Does the image feel like a physical photograph from the 1960s?
Is the color palette cohesive and period-accurate?
Does the composition maintain the heavy top-left typographic weight?
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a desaturated, grainy architectural landscape with bold, high-contrast mid-century display type positioned in the negative space of the sky.
